authoritySafety.reason: The authorized rehearsal used an intentionally granted collegio membership in a dedicated Beta workspace. Historical revoked memberships were not reactivated. After the required receipt and refresh/re-entry evidence were captured, the rehearsal membership was revoked and the workspace archived.

humanFactorsFinding.finding: The first rehearsal UI preselected approve, allowing a consequential institutional outcome to be accepted without an explicit outcome choice.
humanFactorsFinding.remediation: No outcome is now preselected; preview and recording are blocked until an explicit institutional outcome is chosen.

nonClaims: Historical local DecisionAuthority remains self-declared and non-authenticated.
An institutional decision receipt does not mutate the curriculum automatically.
A rehearsal receipt is not a digital signature or protocol record.
The planning handoff remains PREVIEW_ONLY and performs no runtime synchronization into Docente OS.
This tranche does not claim BETA_HIA_PASS or BETA_ACCESSIBILITY_PASS.
nextAction: Begin BETA-G5 Human Interaction Acceptance on desktop and mobile while keeping BETA-G6 accessibility acceptance separate.
